label: PROVEN-GIVEN-ASSUMPTIONS

claim.words: From the v6.3 state before frame 78208 (after the START that opens the pause menu at frame 78207), no pad sequence of length <= 15 makes RAM $A9 == 2 (A (Air Shooter)) and $FD == 0 after a frame; a sequence of length 16 does. Hence, given GA-MENU, the menu closes with the target weapon at frame 78223 at the earliest (closing START frame); v6.3 closes it at frame 78223 (no saving).

assumption_notes: Register ids of docs/proof-standards.md section 6. A-HARNESS applies to every emulator-based claim. A-TAINT is listed because the closure over all 256 pads was checked only on sampled entries; checking it on every entry (pfcheck.py without --classes, or pfcheck_stream.py --all256) removes it. A-CORE-EQ: not yet checked on the judge core.
